【原视频简介】
I gave Qwen 3.8 27B, Ox Alpha, Muse Spark 1.2, and Gemini 3.7 Flash the same open-ended assignment: build an app that turns a text prompt into the best 3D model it can, then test and improve its own result.

The implementations made radically different choices. This edit follows the benchmark across the full stream, compares the visible apps and failure modes, and ends with the goal-weighted ranking and the architecture I would actually keep.
